name: Medical Supply (B2B / Wholesale)
tagline: A wholesale storefront built for clinics and practices.
description: A complete, working wholesale shop for a medical, dental & clinical supplies distributor: a real trade catalogue sold by the case — PPE, consumables, wound care and infection control — with categories, collections, a bespoke trade PDP (per-case pricing, volume breaks, net-30, lot traceability), and a full merchandised home page. Clean clinical theme — crisp cool ground, calm medical-blue, a teal accent. Shipped as Meridian Medical Supplies.
